definitions.confirmed_inflows: Gross provider-confirmed successful events; sandbox results are simulations. Reversals remain separately flagged pending accounting review.
definitions.recorded_outflows: Self-reported expenses plus uncategorized merchant-imported outflows; not a verified expense ledger.
definitions.net_movement: Recorded coverage only; not available bank balance or profit.
definitions.receivables: Issued invoices at range end, less allocations recorded by that date.
